scope: Local synthetic data only; no working accounts, provider connection, push, PR, deployment, new production dependencies or schema migration.
features: Existing client invoice tab extended with invoices, credit notes, totals, source lines, posted customer entries and retained PDF versions.
Both BillingRead and FinanceRead required; legacy BillingRead summary retained. Customer ID is checked by history/PDF endpoints.
Payments filtered before server pagination. Currency, inactive source entries, snapshot coverage and match groups remain explicit.
No financial write or provider sync is triggered by viewing or downloading.

visualNotes: Wrapped finance tabs and related buttons fit 320 px. Amounts, PDF versions and controls remain readable in both themes.
Existing sticky application chrome appears at the active scroll position in full-page hover captures; financial geometry was checked using detail crops too.
Informational spacing findings belong to existing Fluent control geometry; new layout uses 4/8/16/24 px spacing.

intermediateAttempts.findings: Initial fixture assertions used an undefined parameter row, ambiguous text, untranslated internal errors and an inaccurate empty-state string. Assertions now verify the actual protected, translated behavior.
Parallel timing failures under concurrent .NET/SQL builds. Full final run uses two workers with unchanged test timeouts, no retries or skipped cases.

All 683 unit cases passed; a dedicated Playwright suite was incorrectly collected by Vitest. e2e-finance is now classified alongside the existing e2e and e2e-composition directories, and all five browser cases run in their dedicated real API fixture.
Type-only test correction, required sqlcmd SET options, bounded long JSON literals and JSON-result framing in the synthetic seeder. No production validation or index was weakened.
Three functional cases passed; narrow tab overflow and a transient contrast measurement during pending data prevented layout acceptance. Wrapped tabs and stable ready-state measurement fixed both.

limits: No working PowerOffice/account data or Hostinger deployment. Bank verification and full accounting replacement remain outside this view.
No new Atlas, PostgreSQL, Firefox/WebKit or full-stack restore acceptance was run for this Billing/UI change.
Paginated browsing is not a frozen accounting report; refresh after a local import changes the data. PDF parser/malware and legal authenticity limits from the preceding M37 slice remain.
